finding: The report-to-repair loop closes on the lifecycle but not on the decision
what_was_tested: The audit's three deferred decisions were submitted through the governed path and left to run: RQ-20261019-023 (why reports reach no repair), -024 (may knowledge_reuse be enabled), -025 (merge the branch into main).

observed_outcome.produced_hypothesis: e.g. "核心假设：decide / whether / merge" - the task title, tokenised
validator_notes: 未主动寻找反例，存在确认偏误风险
核心关键词在词库中无对应概念，研究背景薄弱

what_this_means: The failure is not that the system claims success. It does not: the receipt is PENDING_EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION and no learning was deposited. That part is honest and fail-closed.

The failure is upstream of the lifecycle. These tasks are data_class=PRIVATE, so the data boundary correctly refuses to send them to any model. With no model, research degrades to keyword extraction from the title, and the validator can see it - it wrote the confirmation-bias objection - but the lifecycle still runs to archived.
So the loop closes on motion and opens on judgement. Everything about the plumbing is correct; nothing about it ever consulted anything that could answer the question.

second_finding.subject: the reuse-pointer guard works, but only on the counting path
second_finding.detail: Validator._unique_evidence returned 3 against 5 stored records, correctly excluding the two archivist task cards the tasks had borrowed from each other. The e168d8e guard holds.
second_finding.but: task.result.evidence_count still reports the raw 5, and evidence_inflation_ratio 1.67 is computed from it. A reader of the research summary sees 5 evidence items where the governance path counted 3.
second_finding.consequence: cosmetic rather than a governance hole, but it is the same class of error as the guard itself was before: two different numbers for the same thing, and only one of them is the honest one.

not_changed: The data boundary refusal is correct and stays. PRIVATE data does not leave the process.
Validator's independent-evidence count stays the authority.
No task was reopened, no receipt rewritten, no threshold loosened.
the_real_question_now: A reasoning task whose whole method is a model call cannot complete when the data class forbids the model. Either such tasks need a classification that permits a model under redaction, or they should be admitted as something other than reasoning. Both are governance decisions, and neither should be made by the executor.
submitted_as: this finding is the answer to RQ-20261019-023, whose own body asked the question
